title: People of God
definition: The People of God are those redeemed by God's mercy, set apart for His glory, and called to proclaim His excellencies.
summary: The People of God are those whom the Lord has called, redeemed, and claimed as His covenant possession.
christFocus: Jesus Christ forms a people for God's possession through His blood and resurrection.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The People of God are those whom God has redeemed, gathered, and claimed as His own. Scripture shows God's saving purpose forming a people for His name, worship, holiness, and mission.

This identity is received by grace, not earned by ethnicity, status, success, or personal strength. God's people are marked by belonging to Him and being shaped by His Word.

Jesus creates and purchases the people of God by His blood. In Him, believers from every background are made one redeemed people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people often define themselves by failure, culture, trauma, ability, or past labels. The doctrine of the People of God gives believers a stronger identity: they belong to the Lord together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as one who belongs to God and to His people. Let this identity reshape your priorities, relationships, worship, and mission, especially when old labels try to name you.
